entries.title: Base image tag is unavailable
entries.root_cause: The runtime base image is pinned to a nonexistent Alpine tag. Correct the tag in the runtime FROM instruction.

entries.title: Builder image tag is unavailable
entries.root_cause: The build stage references a nonexistent Go image tag. Correct the builder FROM instruction.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same manifest lookup fails for the builder stage and requires a separate image tag fix.

entries.title: Base image argument is empty
entries.root_cause: The workflow omits the PULSE_RUNTIME_IMAGE build argument required by the runtime FROM instruction. Supply the argument to the build.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The runtime image reference is empty because a build argument is absent, rather than an unavailable image tag.

entries.title: Build context lacks the container file
entries.root_cause: The build command points to a nonexistent container file. Correct the file path passed to buildx.
